interview.hardest_part: Real-time combat and precise platforming from individual screenshots, especially reading boss attacks quickly enough to jump, strike, and bind with the correct timing. Moss Mother and the Bell Beast are the major progression gates.
interview.likely_failure: Losing too much time to repeated deaths, navigation mistakes, or an early boss—most likely Moss Mother—and then reaching the three-hour limit before the later Citadel-path milestones, dash, and large kill and shard totals.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Death does not end the attempt, saved milestones accumulate, benches restore health and set respawns, and silk binding allows recovery during combat. Early enemies can be farmed for journal kills, rosaries, and shell shards, while cocoon rosaries still count toward scoring.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The game continues while I deliberate, and each decision controls only 0.4 seconds, making rapid reactions and precise movement difficult. Contact damage, hazards, limited starting mobility, death and cocoon recovery, boss gating, and the wall-clock limit all punish slow or inconsistent play.
